step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows an end-to-end data processing pipeline for Ookla's Speedtest data. Consumers submit reports to an API/client which stream into Kinesis Data Streams. The stream enriches data using RDS and forwards enriched JSON to Kinesis Data Firehose, which aggregates into an S3 Data Lake. Athena queries S3 directly. A Lambda function processes landing data into CSVs for Redshift aggregation, with insights written back to RDS.
